faq.title: Most Common Questions
faq.description: Helpful answers before your first visit.

items.question: What can I expect in my first session?
items.answer: We begin with a short consultation, then tailor the treatment pressure, products and pace to your needs.

items.question: Do you offer online therapy?
items.answer: We offer online wellbeing consultations and in-studio treatments for hands-on care.

items.question: How long does it take to see progress?
items.answer: Many guests feel calmer after one visit. Skin and tension goals usually improve with regular sessions.

items.question: Are your therapists licensed and trained?
items.answer: Yes. Each therapist is trained in safe, professional wellness and beauty treatments.

items.question: Is this suitable for sensitive skin or allergies?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us before your session and we will adapt products and oils where needed.
